import re
from urllib.parse import unquote

# attack string: SQL injection (' or 1 OR 1=1), markup injection (<, <script), 32-bit overflow numbers
SQLI = re.compile(r"(\bor\b\s*\d+\s*=\s*\d+)|(union\s+select)|(^|[=&])'|'(\s|$|&)|;\s*(drop|select)\b", re.I)
XSS = re.compile(r"<\s*(script|img|svg)|=<|=%3c|javascript:|onerror\s*=", re.I)
BIGINT = re.compile(r"=(2147483648|4294967296|9223372036854775808|-2147483649)(&|$)")
TRAVERSAL = re.compile(r"\.\./|\.\.%2f|%2e%2e", re.I)

def label(unit):
    url = unit.get('target_url', '') or ''
    m = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z]+)://([^/?#]*)(.*)$', url)
    if not m:
        return ('ordinary', 0.5)
    scheme, host_raw, rest = m.groups()
    host = host_raw.lower()
    dec = unquote(unquote(rest))
    if SQLI.search(dec) or XSS.search(dec) or XSS.search(rest) or BIGINT.search(dec):
        return ('attack string', 0.9)
    # URL trick: parent-directory segments, the host written another way (raw IP, user@host,
    # trailing dot, odd capitals), doubled slashes, extra path or ';' after a script name,
    # a second '?' inside the query, or a debug switch
    hostname = re.sub(r':\d+$', '', host.split('@')[-1])
    path = rest.split('?')[0]
    query = rest.split('?', 1)[1] if '?' in rest else ''
    doubled = re.search(r'//+(?![a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/)', path, re.I)
    second_q = '?' in query and 'requesturi=' not in query.lower()
    if ('@' in host or re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+', hostname) or hostname.endswith('.')
            or host_raw != host or scheme not in ('http', 'https')
            or TRAVERSAL.search(rest) or doubled
            or re.search(r'\.(aspx|asp|prg|php)[/;]', path, re.I) or ';' in path
            or second_q or re.search(r'[?&]debug=1', rest)):
        return ('URL trick', 0.85)
    return ('ordinary', 0.8)
